verdict.rationale: Airbyte documents that programmatic access requires an access token, and its pricing page lists RBAC. Neither shows that a user can issue credentials restricted to particular scopes, workspaces or permissions for an agent. Generic token issuance and user-level RBAC are adjacent controls, not scoped or least-privilege agent credentials.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
